title: Social Worker
description: Lindsay has over 15 years of experience in public and private mental health, working with trauma, anxiety, and complex emotional issues. His approach centers on helping clients understand how trauma resides in the mind, body, and relationships, and translating this understanding into tangible, meaningful change.
